findings.message: The previous finding asked for --dismiss to join the failing case list (exit 1). This fix keeps exit 0 and only adds a stderr line. The failure is now visible on stderr, but a caller that keys on the exit code, such as the skill that reports a tip as dismissed, still reads the missing-lib case as success. It also leaves --dismiss and --undismiss inconsistent for the same lib failure, since the dash shows the exit code. Exit 1 here, or confirm that every caller of --dismiss shows stderr. The 059 exit-0 contract is cited only in a comment and a test name, and nothing in the diff shows --dismiss callers honour it.
findings.scenario: lib/plugins.sh missing, then `specclaw-suggest <dir> --dismiss fleet` -> exit 0 and nothing written. A caller that checks only the exit code tells the user the tip is dismissed, and it reappears on the next run.
